description: An Android app to allow first time Singapore BTO buyers to search for a potential home easily through analysing their financial capability and recommend suitable estates.
HDB BTO Ballot Tracker — estimate Singapore BTO ballot odds from historical subscription rates
Predictor for application rate of Singapore BTO lottery via latitude/longitude. Uses supervised learning models.
This project aims to develop a simple model that is able to track Singapore BTO (Build-To-Order) flat prices over the years, and aims to predict (roughly) BTO prices per district.
